Package neqsim.process.equipment.separator.entrainment

Class EntrainmentResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.separator.entrainment.EntrainmentResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class EntrainmentResult extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable result of an entrainment / carry-over calculation produced by an EnhancedEntrainmentProvider. This is the agreed schema across all providers — both the public built-in 7-stage chain and any private plug-in (such as the EQN π-number model) populate the same fields so downstream consumers (process simulation, plant historians, reports) do not need to know which provider produced the numbers.

Units are SI:

  • Carry-over rates: kg/h
  • Confidence band: kg/h (one-sigma uncertainty estimate on the carry-over rate, when the provider can supply one)

Fields that a provider cannot supply are returned as Double.NaN. In particular, the built-in 7-stage chain returns NaN for getConfidenceBandKgPerHr(); providers that have a documented uncertainty model (e.g. the π-number plug-in scaled against the EQN test envelope) return a finite number.

Droplet-size data. The unified result intentionally does not carry droplet-size distribution or d50, because empirical large-scale correlations (such as the EQN π-number plug-in, which uses Efficiency = f(π)) do not produce them. Providers that compute droplet size internally (e.g. the built-in 7-stage chain) expose it through their own API, not through this cross-provider result schema.

NeqSim

  • Constructor Details

    • EntrainmentResult

      public EntrainmentResult(String providerId, String providerVersion, double oilInGasKgPerHr, double waterInGasKgPerHr, double gasInLiquidKgPerHr, double confidenceBandKgPerHr)
      Constructs an immutable entrainment result.
      Parameters:
      providerId - stable identifier of the provider that produced this result, e.g. "neqsim-7stage" or "eqn-pi-v1"; must not be null
      providerVersion - version string of the provider, e.g. "1.0.0"; must not be null
      oilInGasKgPerHr - oil carry-over into the gas outlet [kg/h], or Double.NaN if not computed
      waterInGasKgPerHr - water carry-over into the gas outlet [kg/h], or Double.NaN if not computed
      gasInLiquidKgPerHr - gas carry-under into the liquid outlet(s) [kg/h], or Double.NaN if not computed
      confidenceBandKgPerHr - one-sigma uncertainty estimate on the carry-over [kg/h], or Double.NaN if the provider cannot supply one
